newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-First Australian U.S. well flows gas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-First Australian U.S. well flows gas.

text.p: First Australian Resources NL said the State Lease 328 No 2 well at Lake Long in South Louisiana, U.S., had produced 1.4 million cubic feet of gas and 48 barrels of condensate a day in a flow test.
The well had been perforated and flow tested from the C-1 sand between 9,704 and 9,714 feet, it said.
The flow was through a 9/64 inch choke at a flowing tubing pressure of 3,050 pounds per square inch.
First Australian Resources has a 30 percent working interest in the well. Operator and other shareholder is Kriti Exploration Inc of Houston, Texas. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
